outline.heading: Assembling your own notebook — the order

points.text: A topic with a question, not "in general." A notebook "about marketing" is dead on arrival.
Sources — 5–15, selected with the three looks.

outline.heading: A notebook lives as long as its question

points.text: A notebook is a workbench, not an archive.

points: Base your topic on a specific question because a notebook about marketing will not work.
Select 5–15 sources using the three looks.
Start with a disagreement question and inspect your materials by stakes.
Choose your format based on the scenario.
Your notebook is a workbench rather than an archive.
